note.title: Editor's note (illustrative)
note.body: In the live product each edition opens with a short note from the editor: what moved in the consensus, where the houses disagree and what to watch next quarter.

houses.worldview: Above-trend US growth with AI doing the heavy lifting: stay pro-risk, but diversify.
houses.keyRisk: An aggressive Fed or an equity-led slowdown.
